whoItsFor: Developers and ML engineers who want agents or models to keep improving from real interaction feedback, using either model-weight training (with GPUs) or harness/prompt optimization (with only a model API endpoint).
useCases: Continually fine-tune a model's weights from scored user or agent interactions using Slime and SGLang
Automatically refine an agent's harness (prompts, rules, skills) from plain-language requests using a model endpoint
Run test-time training on hard problems with a measurable objective and correctness checker

requirements.runtime: Python ≥ 3.12 (per badge), uv recommended, git-lfs system package

installCommand: uv venv && source .venv/bin/activate && uv pip install reef-infra
